model-value.desc: Model of the component of type { min, max } (both values must be between global min/max); use v-model

step.desc: Step amount between valid values (> 0.0); 0 defines infinite granularity

snap.desc: Snap on valid values, rather than sliding freely

color.desc: Color name from the Quasar Color Palette

label.desc: Popup a label when user clicks/taps on the slider thumb

drag-range.desc: User can drag range instead of just the two thumbs

drag-only-range.desc: User can drag only the range instead and NOT the two thumbs

left-label-value.desc: Override default label for min value

right-label-value.desc: Override default label for max value

left-label-color.desc: Color name for left label background

right-label-color.desc: Color name for right label background

dark.desc: Notify the component that the background is a dark color

update:model-value.desc: Emitted when the component needs to change the model; used by v-model

change.desc: Emitted on lazy model value change (after user releases the thumb)

pan.desc: Triggered when user starts/ends panning on the component
